name: Mantle of Goldnight
description: A thick gold chain with a shining medallion symbolizing Avacyn's love and protection, worn by archmages of Goldnight.

description_citations.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn, secretly a lycanthrope, is presented the Mantle of Goldnight and made an archmage in the Elgaud chapel.
timeline.quote: At the correct moment, Arlinn bowed her head, and Reeves slipped the chain around her neck.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.
